nodes.name: Orchestrator
nodes.description: Central hub that registers agents, routes A2A tasks, runs workflows and serves the monitoring dashboard.

orchestrator-api-key.description: Control/webhook endpoints require an X-API-Key header and fail closed (HTTP 503) when unset.

config.name: Orchestrator API Key
config.description: Requests to control/webhook endpoints must carry a valid X-API-Key header.

dashboard-jwt.description: Monitoring dashboard endpoints require a signed JWT; login verifies the submitted password against the bcrypt hash DASHBOARD_PASSWORD_HASH on a worker thread (never plaintext) and is rate limited per client IP.

config.name: Dashboard JWT
config.description: Dashboard API access requires a valid JWT signed with DASHBOARD_JWT_SECRET; the login verifies credentials against DASHBOARD_PASSWORD_HASH with bcrypt.

login-rate-limit.description: The login endpoint allows 5 attempts per minute per client IP, tracked in an in-process sliding window; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

config.name: Login Rate Limit
config.description: Login attempts per client IP are bounded to 5 per minute (application layer; a second layer is the platform load balancer's job).

nodes.name: Qdrant Vector Database
nodes.description: Stores embeddings for semantic search and duplicate detection.

nodes.name: Atlassian MCP Server
nodes.description: Model Context Protocol server bridging agents and Atlassian (Jira and Confluence).

nodes.name: Google Cloud Run
nodes.description: Managed runtime hosting the orchestrator, agents and supporting services.

nodes.name: Jira
nodes.description: External issue tracker; source of requirements and webhooks, target for incidents.

nodes.name: Zephyr
nodes.description: External test management system receiving test results.

nodes.name: LLM Provider
nodes.description: External LLM provider(s): Google Gemini by default, with Anthropic Claude 5 family and self-hosted Qwen as configured model options. Provider HTTP clients carry transport-level retries, per-operation token metering feeds the dashboard, and max output tokens / thinking effort are resolved per provider.

nodes.name: Test Execution Agents
nodes.description: External UI and API test execution agents that run test cases and expose an A2A endpoint guarded by a shared bearer token.

nodes.name: RAG Sync Job
nodes.description: Synchronizes Jira issues (and later Confluence pages) into the Qdrant vector DB. Runs as a Cloud Run Job triggered by the orchestrator, or as a local sync service in development.

vector-db-api-key.description: Calls to Qdrant carry the shared QDRANT_API_KEY when one is configured.

config.name: Qdrant API Key
config.description: Every client into the vector database authenticates with the shared QDRANT_API_KEY when one is configured.

nodes.name: Confluence
nodes.description: Atlassian Confluence Cloud, source of the documents ingested into the RAG vector DB.

nodes.name: Microsoft SharePoint
nodes.description: Microsoft SharePoint document libraries (drive items), source of the documents ingested into the RAG vector DB.

execution-agent-bearer-token.description: When REMOTE_EXECUTION_AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN is set, the orchestrator presents it as an Authorization: Bearer token on the agents' guarded main A2A endpoint; the agents reject mismatching or missing tokens with HTTP 401.

config.name: Execution Agent Bearer Token
config.description: Calls to the execution agents' main A2A endpoint are authenticated with a shared bearer token.

jira-webhook-hmac.description: Webhook requests must carry a valid X-Hub-Signature HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body; invalid or missing signatures are rejected.

config.name: Jira Webhook HMAC Signature
config.description: Inbound Jira webhook payloads are authenticated with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.
